If the secured equipment/capital lease debt is properly included (as the definition requires), the ratio is **3.74x**. The Certificate's own note concedes the formula produces 3.6765x but \"report[s]\" 3.15x by reference to an undisclosed \"methodology note.\" This is an Event of Default under Section 8.01(d) unless cured, and the certification of \"no Default\" raises a separate misrepresentation issue under Section 8.01(c). The equity cure window for the Q3 2024 test appears to close on or about **November 29, 2024** (10 Business Days after the November 14, 2024 Certificate due date) and would require a cash equity contribution of roughly **$9.0–$10.3 million**. This is the most urgent issue in this memo and should be raised with the deal team immediately.")
N("**The Total Net Leverage Ratio is also misstated.** The Certificate uses the senior secured net debt figure ($251.2M) as the numerator and a hardcoded 3.72x. The correct figure is $255.4M / $68.3M = **3.74x** (headroom 0.26x, not 0.28x, against 4.00x). At the 3.75x level that first applies to the March 31, 2025 test, static headroom is **0.01x** — roughly $0.2 million of EBITDA.")
N("**Change of Control is triggered, but it is NOT a sacred right.** Ridgeline's acquisition of 100% of the equity exceeds the 35% threshold in clause (a) of the \"Change of Control\" definition and Ridgeline is not a Permitted Holder (confirmed). Change of Control is an immediate Event of Default under Section 8.01(k) with no grace period or cure right. However, contrary to the preliminary view in your memo, Section 10.01(b) does not list Change of Control (or the related definitions or Section 8.01(k)) among the sacred rights, so a waiver/amendment requires only **Required Lenders** (more than 50% of outstanding Term Loans plus Revolving Credit Commitments) under Section 10.01(a) — not unanimous consent. Trident (35%) cannot approve alone but, with any one other Lender, can deliver Required Lenders; the three non-agent Lenders together (65%) could also approve without Trident.")
N("**Distributions to service ~$40 million of holdco debt are not currently available under the general basket.** The Section 7.06(c) basket requires pro forma Total Net Leverage of 3.00x or lower (we are at 3.74x; ~$50.5M of net debt reduction or ~$16.8M of EBITDA growth is needed) and is capped at $7.5M per fiscal year. On the current EBITDA trajectory and scheduled amortization, 3.00x is not reached until roughly the Q2/Q3 2026 test, months before the March 15, 2027 maturity. The Available Amount basket (Section 7.06(d)) has no leverage test but is blocked while any Default exists — including the apparent SSNLR breach. The tax distribution basket is drafted for a pass-through entity and appears inapplicable to Vantage, a Delaware corporation, which also calls into question the $8.55M of \"tax distributions\" made during the trailing four quarters.")
N("**The equity cure is single-prong (EBITDA only) and cannot be used for the Restricted Payments test.** Cure proceeds increase Consolidated EBITDA \"solely for purposes of determining compliance with Section 7.11\" and expressly do not reduce debt (Section 8.01(e)(i)–(ii)); the Minimum Liquidity covenant is not curable; cures are limited to 2 in any four consecutive quarters and 4 over the life of the facility, with no over-cure permitted.")
N("**Drafting defects and inconsistencies.** (i) A monthly Borrowing Base Certificate is required (Section 6.02(c) / Exhibit H) although the Revolver is not a borrowing base facility and \"Borrowing Base,\" \"Eligible Accounts Receivable\" and advance rates are nowhere defined — a template artifact that creates technical default risk; (ii) the asset sale reinvestment period is 180 days in Section 2.05(b)(i) but 365 days in Section 7.05(d)(iv); (iii) the benchmark provisions are incomplete (Section 1.06 is still captioned \"LIBOR Notification,\" there is no hardwired benchmark replacement waterfall, \"Base Rate\" is referenced but never defined, and the Agent may unilaterally select a replacement rate); (iv) numerous capitalized terms are undefined (e.g., \"Investment,\" \"Subordinated Indebtedness,\" \"Capital Lease Obligations,\" \"Related Parties,\" \"Working Capital,\" \"Base Rate\").")
P("**Recommendation in one paragraph.** Given (a) an apparent existing covenant default, (b) covenant step-downs that leave virtually no headroom in 2025, (c) Restricted Payment capacity that is effectively unavailable for the holdco debt service the model assumes, (d) no prepayment premium on the Term Loan (Section 2.05(a)), and (e) a March 15, 2027 maturity only ~28 months out, I recommend that the deal team plan for a **full refinancing at closing** as the base case, with a Required Lender consent/amendment as a fallback only if a refinancing cannot be executed on the deal timeline. The purchase agreement should allocate the risk of the existing default (specific indemnity / covenant to cure / closing condition) and require delivery of payoff letters. We should also immediately request the historical compliance certificates and the \"methodology note\" referenced in the Certificate, because the historical tracking schedule suggests the SSNLR may have been misreported since 2022.")

# Executive Summary

You asked for a full extraction and analysis of the covenant package in the \$385 million senior secured Credit Agreement dated as of March 15, 2022 (the \"Credit Agreement\") among Vantage Industrial Solutions, Inc. (\"Vantage\" or the \"Borrower\"), the Guarantors, Trident National Bank, N.A. (\"Trident\") as Administrative Agent, and the Lenders. I reviewed in full (1) the Credit Agreement, including all Exhibits and Schedules, (2) the Q3 2024 Compliance Certificate dated November 12, 2024 signed by Janet Thibodaux, CFO (the \"Certificate\"), and (3) your November 8, 2024 priorities memo. If the secured equipment/capital lease debt is properly included (as the definition requires), the ratio is **3.74x**. The Certificate\'s own note concedes the formula produces 3.6765x but \"report\[s\]\" 3.15x by reference to an undisclosed \"methodology note.\" This is an Event of Default under Section 8.01(d) unless cured, and the certification of \"no Default\" raises a separate misrepresentation issue under Section 8.01(c). The equity cure window for the Q3 2024 test appears to close on or about **November 29, 2024** (10 Business Days after the November 14, 2024 Certificate due date) and would require a cash equity contribution of roughly **\$9.0--\$10.3 million**. This is the most urgent issue in this memo and should be raised w11356
